The '''LCK 2021 Summer''' Split was the second split of the 2021 season of the [[League of Legends Champions Korea]], organized by Riot Games. The competition ran from June 9 to August 28, 2021, with the regular season played offline at LoL Park in Seoul. The Playoffs were held at the same venue, with the Finals staged at the CJ ENM Studio Center in Ilsan. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin regular season with best-of-three matches, and the top six advanced to a single-elimination Playoffs played as best-of-five. The winner qualified for the [[World Championship/2021|2021 World Championship]]. The split was played on patches 11.11 through 11.16.

==Format==
*'''Regular Season''' - ''June 9th - August 15th, 2021''
**Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd till 6th place''}} advance to the Wild Card Round of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 10th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
*'''Playoffs''' - ''August 18th - August 28th, 2021''
** Single Elimination
** 1st placed team from group stage can choose the opponent from first round
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner qualifies for [[World Championship/2021|World Championship 2021]]
